checks.name: chromium: interactive tutorial, modal keyboard trap and focus return
checks.evidence: Four tutorial steps completed by touch; WCAG-tagged axe scan 0 violations; dialog traps Tab and restores focus.

checks.name: chromium: keyboard selection/rotation, pause, help, restart and saved progress
checks.evidence: Enter selects without spending; arrows move focus; R rotates; pause freezes virtual time; reload restores paused board; restart cancel/confirm works.

checks.name: chromium: full three-garden win, growth spending, best, PNG, overlay URL fallback
checks.evidence: All 3 boards won via UI; charge spent once for +150; Demo best persisted; real 1200×675 PNG downloaded; denied clipboard exposes complete manual-copy URL.

checks.name: chromium: complete mobile touch win, genuine move-loss, restart and first screen
checks.evidence: 390×844 main action fully visible; full 3-board win by taps without dragging; actual loss at 11 moves; Play again resets game.

checks.name: chromium: idle Live Garden, repeats, energy cap, epoch/reconnect and next-board seed
checks.evidence: Idle live starts at zero energy; repeated samples award nothing; new paired movement caps reservoir at 3; epoch and outage rebaseline; board survives all feed changes.

checks.name: chromium: historical round pinning, selection, actual network and cross-device reproduction
checks.evidence: Safe round 1214 is default; chain label and explorer are Sepolia; separate contexts generate identical boards; non-contiguous round 1201 is selectable; a pinned tx URL takes precedence over a different saved tx in the same round.

checks.name: chromium: unavailable API, explicit Demo recovery and storage denial
checks.evidence: No random fallback for unavailable historical source; explicit Play Demo starts fixture; denied localStorage shows warning and game still works.

checks.name: chromium: real 16:9 overlay, controls toggle and source-dependent board
checks.evidence: 1920×1080 overlay is exactly 16:9, source/mode/freshness retained; same actual engine; Show/Hide controls and real rotation work; a standalone hidden-controls game continues its actual clock.

checks.name: chromium: responsive reflow, reduced motion, accessibility, contrast and focus
chromium: timer expiry, sound toggle and separate local mode bests
checks.evidence: Virtual clock reaches genuine 0:00 loss and restart; sound starts off, enables only on click and toggles off; Demo best reads its mode key; an unplayed archive does not inherit the mode-wide best.

checks.name: chromium: same-browser overlay follows real live progress without duplicate charge accounting
checks.evidence: Separate pages in one browser share actual live board, bloom and 3→2 charge spend; display-only overlay neither awards energy nor overwrites controller storage.

checks.name: chromium: IDLE core with moving wheel is live on every surface
checks.evidence: Explicit moving IDLE-core fixture (66.053 rpm, 967 mm/s): Live badge, wheel heading, accessible name, details and overlay all report live.

checks.name: chromium: hidden interval preserves pending baseline and grants no gap energy
checks.evidence: 30 virtual hidden seconds: zero requests, hidden explanation retained; +27,000 mm on return grants 0; subsequent +1,500 mm grants exactly 1. No moves spent.

checks.name: chromium: pause, loading and failure covers sit above selected and focused tiles
checks.evidence: 390×844 hit-testing confirms pause/loading/error covers above selected tiles; covered boards have no tile tab stop.

checks.name: chromium: source loading and failure copy never imply a settled practice source
checks.evidence: Pending archive uses Waiting for a settled round / Not loaded / Unavailable; Checking the wheel has no false failure paragraph or resting accessible name.

checks.name: chromium: outage recovery stays in the first-screen board cover
checks.evidence: Blocked transport yields actionable cover message, visible Retry and explicit Play Demo at 390×664; Retry loads real-shaped historical fixture, removing cover and duplicate error block.

checks.name: chromium: browser modifier shortcuts spend no rotations and remain uncancelled
checks.evidence: Ctrl/Meta/Alt+R on board and action row: not prevented, 0 moves. Plain r and Shift+R still rotate. Initial selection is wheel with Rotate disabled.
